name: Product Experience, Accessibility, and Interaction Architecture
description: Information architecture, cockpit navigation model, command and search experience, progressive disclosure, agent activity visualization, authority and approval UX, recovery and failure UX, collaboration UX, extension management UX, account and organization UX, keyboard-first operation, screen reader semantics, reduced motion and contrast, localization architecture, responsive desktop and mobile layouts, empty and transitional states, user research loop, and product experience acceptance suite.
objective: Design and implement the product experience: navigation, accessibility (WCAG), localization, agent visualization, and UX acceptance suite.
